method: Use the exact named Google Maps campground point, corroborated by the current operator address and campground map. Seattle estimates use the no-ferry I-5 and Tacoma Narrows route for consistency because ferry waits and sailing availability are not represented reliably in a static estimate; displayed times round the observed route up to a practical planning interval.
